We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: This role leads the engineering organization that owns how PayPal creates, protects, distributes, rotates, and retires cryptographic material - keys, certificates, secrets, and the services and hardware that sit behind them. You will lead managers and senior engineers across public key infrastructure and certificate lifecycle management, key management and HSM platforms, cryptographic libraries and services, secrets management, and the enterprise crypto-agility and post-quantum readiness program. Job Description: Essential Responsibilities: Provide expert advice and strategic counsel to senior executives, shaping the development of multi-year security strategies that align with business goals and long-term objectives. Determine the most effective methods and strategies for addressing complex security challenges, driving innovation through collaboration with cross-functional teams to shape the organization’s security landscape. Identify and resolve unique, high-impact security challenges, applying deep expertise to situations of substantial significance, and developing innovative solutions that influence the organization’s security framework. Drive the future technology roadmap, shaping the security vision that supports and enables business growth and competitive advantage. Lead the development and execution of key components of the multi-year security strategy, contributing to the broader security agenda within the organization. Inspire and motivate team(s) to pursue innovative solutions, ensuring alignment with the overall security strategy and business objectives, while fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. Minimum Qualifications: 10+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. 2 years of experience leading others Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications : Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Roughly 12+ years in software, platform, or security engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams and experience leading other managers. Ownership of production cryptographic infrastructure at enterprise scale, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, key management, HSMs, or cryptographic services, with applied fluency in TLS and trust stores, key hierarchies and rotation, and HSM integration. This is an engineering leadership role rather than a cryptographic research role. Experience running platforms under regulatory scrutiny, PCI DSS, SOC 2, FIPS 140-2/140-3, or comparable, and working directly with auditors and examiners. A track record of large migrations across many dependent teams where success depended on influence and sequencing rather than direct authority, and the communication skills to give executives the risk and the decision rather than the cryptography. You will shape the strategy, delivery, and operational health of PayPal's cryptographic platforms — the foundation beneath uninterrupted payment availability, provable regulatory compliance, and a credible path to quantum-resistant cryptography ahead of external deadlines. Concretely, most of that impact comes through the organization you build and lead: Managers and engineers across PKI, key management, cryptographic services, and post-quantum readiness work from one roadmap instead of several competing ones, and know how their work ladders into it. Leaders in the portfolio take on real scope, make their own calls, and develop successors behind them. In a specialist field this small, retention is a leadership outcome long before it is a recruiting one. Cloud Modernization, Platform Engineering, Identity, SRE, Risk, and Compliance adopt cryptographic standards because the case is clear and the partnership is real. What is exposed, what it would cost, and what you propose to do about it — framed so leadership can decide on time rather than after an incident. Additional Responsibilities Lead a multi-team organization of managers, technical leads, and engineers across time zones, setting direction and staying close enough to the technology to make good calls without becoming the bottleneck. Hire, develop, and retain cryptographic engineering talent, building bench strength and succession in a domain where single points of knowledge are a business continuity risk. Own the multi-year roadmap across PKI and certificate lifecycle management, key management and HSM platforms, cryptographic services, and secrets, including vendor strategy across CAs, HSM manufacturers, and CLM platforms. Drive the enterprise crypto-agility and post-quantum program, from cryptographic inventory and risk-ranking through migration waves and executive-level reporting. Push certificate and key operations toward automation by default, ACME and API-driven issuance, self-service onboarding, short-lived credentials, with named ownership for every certificate in the estate. Lead through cryptography-related incidents and regulatory examinations alike, partnering with Compliance, Internal Audit, and Risk on PCI DSS and SOC, and converting findings into durable control changes. Represent cryptography to the CISO's leadership team and to business and engineering executives, and track where the field is heading, standards drafts, CA/Browser Forum ballots, NIST and NSA guidance, so PayPal's plans adjust early. 쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성(Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술(High-tech), 초연결사회(Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

쿠팡 프라이버시 컴플라이언스 모니터링팀은 국내외 전 사업 영역에서 개인정보, 위치정보 등 데이터가 관련 법규 및 글로벌 보안 기준에 따라 적절히 관리되고 있는지 모니터링하고 평가합니다. 단순히 규제 준수 여부를 점검하는 것을 넘어, 컴플라이언스 컨트롤 타워 역할을 수행하며 식별된 리스크가 실제 비즈니스 프로세스 내에서 신속하게 해결될 수 있도록 지원합니다. Senior Principal, Compliance는 이러한 쿠팡 프라이버시 컴플라이언스 모니터링팀의 시니어 전문가로써 데이터 보호에 대한 신뢰를 확보하고 컴플라이언스 체계를 고도화하는데 기여합니다.

업무 내용

•

개인정보 및 위치정보 관련 법령과 글로벌 기준을 기반으로 전사 수준의 컴플라이언스 모니터링 전략을 수립

•

국내외 서비스와 내부 업무 프로세스 전반에 대해 정기 및 상시로 규제 준수 여부를 점검하고 평가

•

식별된 리스크의 비즈니스 영향도를 분석하고 중요도에 따라 대응 우선순위를 결정

•

미준수 사항에 대한 개선조치의 적정성과 효과성을 검증하고 기술적·관리적 보완 여부를 확인

•

외부 수탁사의 개인정보 보호 수준을 점검하고 리스크 완화를 위한 관리 및 개선 활동을 수행

자격 요건

• 학사 이상 학위를 보유하고 국내외 개인정보 컴플라이언스 관련 실무 경험 15년 이상이신 분
• 개인정보보호법, 위치정보법 등 관련 법규에 대한 깊이 있는 이해와 실무 적용 역량을 보유하신 분
• 대규모 조직에서 개인정보 관리체계 또는 모니터링 프레임워크를 직접 설계 및 운영한 경험이 있으신 분
• 다양한 내·외부 이해관계자와 효과적으로 협업하고 복잡한 이슈를 조율할 수 있는 뛰어난 커뮤니케이션 역량을 보유하신 분
• 높은 윤리의식과 책임감을 바탕으로 능동적으로 문제를 해결하려는 태도를 갖추신 분

우대 사항

• 이커머스 및 IT 플랫폼 등 대규모 개인정보를 처리하는 테크기업에서의 컴플라이언스 경험을 보유하신 분
• 클라우드 네이티브 환경 및 MSA에 대한 기술적 이해를 보유하신 분
• 개인정보보호 또는 정보보호 관련 석·박사 학위와 함께 비즈니스 영어 커뮤니케이션 및 영문 기술 문서 작성 역량을 갖추신 분
• CISA, CISSP, ISMS-P, ISO27001, CPPG 등 관련 자격증을 보유하고 데이터 분석 기반의 컴플라이언스 점검 자동화 및 업무 효율화 경험이 있으신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

• 전형 절차

• 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
• 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
• 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

• 참고 사항

• 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
• 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
• 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
• 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
• 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

• 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

• 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy

서류 반환 정책

• 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
• 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
• 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
• 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
• 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

직무 소개
풀필먼트 센터(FC), 캠프 및 데이터 센터의 안전하고 효율적인 엔터프라이즈 네트워크 인프라를 설계, 배포 및 유지 관리할 Staff Network Engineer를 찾고 있습니다. 이 역할은 비즈니스 요구사항을 이해하고 사용자 및 고객을 위한 네트워크 문제를 해결하며 최적화하는 네트워크 팀의 선임 역할을 수행하게 됩니다. 성공적인 업무 수행을 위해 뛰어난 문제 해결 능력, 위기 관리 능력, 그리고 타 부서와의 원활한 커뮤니케이션 및 콜라보레이션 역량이 필수적입니다. 또한, 쿠팡의 분산된 물류 인프라 환경을 지원하기 위해 현장 이동 및 출장에 제약이 없어야 하며, 글로벌 환경에서 다양한 국가의 팀원들과 유연하게 협업하고 프로젝트를 완수할 수 있는 역량이 요구됩니다.

풀필먼트 센터(FC), 딜리버리 센터(캠프) 및 데이터 센터를 지원하는 엔터프라이즈 네트워크 인프라(LAN, WLAN, WAN, Network Security)를 설계, 기획, 구축 및 유지 관리
FC 설계 팀과 협력하여 확장 가능하고 탄력적이며 비용이 최적화된 네트워크 아키텍처를 개발
자동화, 로보틱스, FC 운영, 인프라, 보안 및 기타 IT 팀, 외부 벤더와 협력하여 비즈니스 요구사항을 파악하고 효과적인 네트워크 솔루션 제공
심각한 인시던트 및 서비스 중단 시 기술적 대응을 주도하며, 복잡한 네트워크, 무선, WAN 및 보안 관련 문제(위기 관리 및 문제 해결)를 해결
네트워크 성능, 가용성 및 트래픽 데이터를 심층적으로 분석하여 잠재적 문제를 선제적으로 예방하고 인프라를 지속적으로 최적화
네트워크 표준, 아키텍처 설계서, 운영 가이드 및 장애 보고서(RCA) 등 고품질의 기술 문서화를 수행하고 자산화
안전한 네트워크 환경 내에서 자동화, 로보틱스, 창고 시스템 및 엔터프라이즈 애플리케이션의 배포, 통합 및 운영 관리를 지원
다양하고 복잡한 프로젝트를 관리하며, 팀원의 지도 및 교육(멘토링)을 수행
보안, 소프트웨어, 운영 및 글로벌 네트워크 표준에 대한 규정 준수를 보장
비즈니스 성장을 지원하기 위해 네트워크 용량 계획, 하드웨어 교체, 소프트웨어 유지보수를 포함한 수명 주기 활동을 관리
자격
요건
대규모 엔터프라이즈 네트워크 설계, 기획, 구축 및 운영 관련 경력 최소 10년 이상 보유하신 분
통신 프로토콜(TCP/IP 등), 라우팅 프로토콜(예: BGP, OSPF), 스위칭 기술에 대한 심도 깊은 이해와 탄탄한 배경 지식을 보유하신 분

Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled Staff Network Engineer to design, plan, deploy, and maintain a secure and efficient enterprise network infrastructure supporting our Fulfillment Centers (FCs), Camps, and Data Centers. In this role, you will serve as a senior technical leader within the network team, driving solutions for complex network issues and optimizing the environment for our users and customers. The ideal candidate must possess exceptional problem-solving abilities, crisis management skills, and strong cross-functional collaboration capabilities. As our logistics infrastructure is geographically distributed, this position requires flexibility for business travel and onsite visits, alongside a solid command of English to seamlessly collaborate with global teams and vendors.
What You Will Do
Design, plan, implement, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure (LAN, WLAN, WAN, and Network Security) supporting Fulfillment Centers (FCs), Camps, and Data Centers.
Partner with FC Design teams to develop scalable, resilient, and cost-optimized network architectures.
Collaborate with Automation, Robotics, FC Operations, Infrastructure, Security, and other IT teams, as well as external vendors, to understand business requirements and deliver effective network solutions.
Lead technical response and drive resolution during critical incidents, outages, and complex network, wireless, WAN, or security-related issues (Crisis Management & Troubleshooting).
Deeply analyze network performance, availability, and traffic data to proactively prevent potential issues and continuously optimize infrastructure.
Author and maintain high-quality technical documentation, including network standards, architectural blueprints, operational guides, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports.
Support the deployment, integration, and operational management of automation, robotics, warehouse systems, and enterprise applications within a secure network environment.
Manage network lifecycle activities, including capacity planning, hardware refreshes, and software maintenance to support growing businesses.
Ensure compliance with security, software, operational, and global network standards across all infrastructure.
Provide mentorship, technical guidance, and training to team members and junior engineers.

10+ years of industry-related experience designing, planning, deploying, and operating large-scale enterprise networks.
In-depth understanding of communication protocols (mainly TCP/IP), routing protocols (e.g., BGP, OSPF), switching technologies, and network security.
Expertise in Cisco and Juniper (HPE) enterprise switching and wireless infrastructure technologies.
Hands-on experience designing and operating enterprise security and network infrastructure solutions (Fortinet/Palo Alto/Zscaler Firewalls and VPNs, Cisco ISE, DHCP, etc.).
Strong data-driven analytical skills using network diagnostic/monitoring tools, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear documentation.
Sharp troubleshooting skills under high-pressure environments and proven crisis management capabilities.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills to work effectively with internal teams and external global vendors.
Ability to communicate business-level English and Korean
Willingness and ability to travel to geographically distributed Fulfillment Centers and Camps without restrictions.
Good knowledge of passive networking technologies and structured cabling infrastructure.
Preferred Qualifications
15+ years of relevant experience, with a Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronic Engineering, or a related field.
Proven experience collaborating with multinational teams or overseas members, possessing cultural adaptability and a flexible mindset to drive global initiatives to success.
Proficiency in network automation design and implementation using Python scripting, Ansible, or similar tools.
CCNP, JNCIP, CCIE, JNCIE, or equivalent industry certifications.
Prior experience working in a logistics network or warehouse operation environment.
Excellent knowledge of network project management principles.

jobs.description: The Amazon Now Design Engineering team is seeking an innovative, solutions-oriented Design Engineer to help shape the next generation of Quick Commerce facilities and enable the rapid expansion of Amazon’s Same-Day Delivery network. Embrace the opportunity to solve complex, real-world problems through innovative and scalable design solutions. You will apply your engineering, analytical, and systems-design expertise to develop facility concepts that optimize space, capacity, material flow, associate experience, and operational efficiency. You will help translate evolving business and operational requirements into practical, scalable designs that can be deployed across a diverse network of sites. The role requires the ability to travel approximately 25% to collaborate with internal and external business, operational, construction, and technical leaders and to support site-level design and implementation. Key job responsibilities • Create detailed 2D CAD and facility layout designs for Amazon Now sites, integrating operational workflows, storage, material handling, decant, staging, delivery, and other facility requirements based on capacity targets and site-specific constraints. • Lead and coordinate design efforts to develop optimized Quick Commerce facility solutions, balancing capacity, space utilization, associate experience, operational efficiency, safety, constructability, and cost. • Develop scalable, template-based design solutions and standards that can be deployed across the Amazon Now network while adapting to the unique physical and operational characteristics of individual sites. • Develop and present comprehensive technical documentation, including design packages, layouts, engineering calculations, design rationale, and recommendations that clearly communicate how proposed solutions meet business and operational requirements. • Partner closely with internal teams and external stakeholders across Operations, Real Estate, Construction, Workplace Health & Safety, Industrial Engineering, Technology, vendors, and other technical teams to deliver high-quality and cost-effective facility solutions. • Translate business and operational requirements into detailed design strategies, roadmaps, and technical solutions, communicating complex engineering concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. • Continuously refine and iterate designs based on stakeholder feedback, site conditions, operational data, lessons learned, and evolving business requirements to improve network scalability, efficiency, and customer experience. • Evaluate site-specific constraints and develop practical engineering solutions that enable Amazon Now launches while maintaining alignment with design standards, operational requirements, safety expectations, and construction requirements. • Ensure design solutions meet applicable safety, operational, accessibility, and sustainability requirements while optimizing facility capacity, associate experience, space utilization, and overall cost. • Stay current with emerging CAD technologies, automation, material handling systems, and industrial engineering best practices to continuously improve design tools, methodologies, and workflows. • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of Amazon Now design standards, templates, mechanisms, and best practices, helping establish scalable solutions for the broader network. • Support design reviews, permit submissions, construction coordination, and site-level implementation by providing technical guidance and resolving design issues throughout the project lifecycle. A day in the life A typical day as an Amazon Now Design Engineer involves balancing technical design, analytical problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration. You’ll dive into CAD tools to create, refine, and review Quick Commerce facility layouts, translating operational requirements and site constraints into practical, scalable design solutions. You’ll analyze capacity requirements, site attributes, and operational workflows to inform design decisions and ensure facilities can support current and future business needs. Working closely with Operations, Industrial Engineering, Construction, Real Estate, Workplace Health & Safety, and other technical teams, you’ll translate evolving requirements into detailed facility designs. You’ll manage multiple projects simultaneously, participate in design reviews, and collaborate with architects, civil engineers, construction teams, and external partners to develop and resolve detailed design requirements. You’ll also investigate site-specific challenges, perform capacity and space-utilization analyses, and develop solutions when standard designs need to be adapted to unique conditions. As the Amazon Now network continues to evolve, you’ll help identify opportunities to improve design standards, templates, processes, and mechanisms. You’ll stay current with emerging technologies, automation, material handling solutions, and industry best practices, applying these learnings to improve scalability and efficiency across the network. The role requires a balance of analytical thinking, creative problem-solving, engineering judgment, attention to detail, and strong communication. You’ll be expected to navigate ambiguity, make data-driven design decisions, collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders, and deliver high-quality solutions in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities and deadlines. About the team The Amazon Now Design Organization’s mission is to enable a fast, scalable, and customer-centric Quick Commerce network that brings a wider selection closer to customers across urban and rural communities. We design and launch innovative solutions that optimize network capacity, improve operational efficiency, and adapt to the unique needs and constraints of each site. Through a data-driven approach and strong partnerships across Operations, Business, Technology, Design, Construction, and Workplace Health & Safety, we transform complex requirements into scalable, buildable solutions that enable Amazon Now to launch and grow at speed. Our team continuously evolves design standards, processes, and mechanisms to support new customer and business needs while maintaining a consistent and high-quality experience across the network. If you are passionate about solving complex problems, thrive in ambiguity, enjoy working across diverse teams, and are relentless in finding practical solutions that improve the customer experience, you will find the Amazon Now Design Organization to be an AMAZING place to work.
